title: Authentication Bypass in /api/login endpoint
description: The /api/login endpoint allows unauthorized access by bypassing authentication checks, enabling unauthorized user sessions.
impact: An attacker can gain access to user accounts and perform actions on behalf of authenticated users.
technical_analysis: The /api/login endpoint lacks proper authentication validation, allowing attackers to send crafted requests without valid credentials.
poc_description:
1. Send a POST request to /api/login with empty credentials.
2. Observe the response grants access without authentication.
remediation_steps: Implement proper authentication validation in the /api/login endpoint. Use middleware to enforce session tokens and validate credentials before granting access.
assumptions: Assumes the attacker can send unauthenticated requests to the /api/login endpoint.
counterevidence: No authentication checks were found in the endpoint's code, but the vulnerability was confirmed via PoC.
severity_change_conditions: If the endpoint is accessible over HTTPS with no encryption, the severity would decrease.
